name: 消波螺
evolution: 波波螺 → 消波螺 Lv.16 → 嗜波螺 Lv.32
description: 进化后，外壳生长速度更快，更需要精心维护——它们会定期在岩石上打磨外壳。个体之间还会互相叠在一起摩擦打磨，发出“砰砰”的声响。若较长时间没有打磨，行动会明显变慢。
descriptionEn: After evolving, its shell grows even faster and needs more careful maintenance — they regularly grind their shells on rocks. Individuals also pile on top of one another to rub and grind, making a “bang bang” sound. If they go without grinding for a long time, their movement slows noticeably.
